plans.idea: Big product on the left filling nearly the full height, with one left-aligned right column that reads top to bottom: headline and subcopy, the badge pair, the Order Now button, then legal on the bottom edge.

Copy-led editorial split: the badge pair sits above the headline as a small label, then the headline, subcopy and CTA stack in a left column on one shared left edge, with the product in its own column on the right.

Keeps the original's three-column billboard (product, then message, then action) but stretches it to 16:9: the product sits left, headline, subcopy and badges are in the centre, the CTA is centred on its own on the right, and the legal runs along the bottom.
